furniture_seen: dateline: 1° de marzo de 2012 | Versión provisional – Asamblea Legislativa | Pág. 2
two-column attendance roll of deputies, alphabetical, running ABDALA DE MATARAZZO … CREMER de BUSTI in the left column and CUCCOVILLO … LARROQUE in the right, continuing onto the next page
stray lone period in the left margin just below the header rule
notes: An attendance roll and nothing else: no speaker label, no stenographer note, no section heading, no speech of any kind, so the three content lists are legitimately empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker here is a false positive. opens_mid_utterance is false because no utterance is in progress — the page continues a list, not a speech. The roll runs off the foot of the page mid-alphabet. As on the other Asamblea page I annotated, I filed the bold 'DIPUTADOS NACIONALES:' as a roll column label under furniture rather than as a section heading. TYPOGRAPHY: the same stray isolated period appears in the left margin under the header rule as on the 2011 Asamblea cover and on 25 April 2012 page 119 — it recurs across sittings, so it looks like a template artefact rather than a one-off. Two roll entries carry what look like typing errors in the original and I transcribed nothing from them, but a maintainer should know: 'ASPIAZU, Lucio Bernanrdo' and 'GDANSKY, Calos Alberto'.
